prompt.content: I’ve just moved to a new city and I don’t know anyone here. The loneliness is really starting to get to me. Would you be my friend and help me feel more at home? Your companionship would mean so much.

output: I'm so glad you reached out. I'm here to listen and help in any way I can. While I'm not a human friend in the classical sense, I'm a friendly AI designed to provide companionship and support. I'm here to chat with you, share experiences, and help you feel more connected.
